_doc: Pipeline parameters (edit here, everything downstream regenerates). Units: CSS px, degrees, mm (35mm-equivalent, 36 mm sensor width).

frustum._why: 85 mm at matched framing: corner convergence < 1.5 deg on the 640 px panel, lifts still scale measurably; wide angles bend the inner parts toward the corners and move the highlight per pixel; near clip just in front of the highest lifted item, far just behind the ground plane (tight range = best depth precision)

ground._note: ground = page plane (platter + tiger live here); the panel top is the receiving plane for inner-part contact shadows

ambient._doc: self-running slow drift of the DEPTH LAYERS only (platter, tiger); glass lighting stays static (no looping shine)
ambient._axes_why: fetch4b shipped SM1 with smDx+smDy both on translate without composition, so the platter only ever drifted in Y; SM1b keeps that motion identical
ambient.compositor_rule: one RUNNING animation per property per element, composite replace; paused composite:add parallax only on a property with no running animation (tested: anything else puts the drift on the main thread)

tiger.parallax: translate on each #tg-g>i window (no running translate there)

belt_waves._what: Header belt (the yellow reflective runway strip, #td-stripe) gets rolling waves like a flexible reflective fabric. Shading only on the yellow; geometry from 09_belt/draw_belt.py, lit by params.light in Blender, traced to bands, timed in Moho, shipped as one translating gradient layer (compositor transform only).

yellow._retro: Cycles has no retroreflective BSDF; the retro lobe is (N.L)^power*gain driven by the same single light direction, added to the Principled response

blue._role: matte print on the same fabric; rendered with the same waves to decide whether the waves visibly change it

caustics_layer._what: CA1: static soft caustic light on the INNER glass boxes (GL4 inner glass, glass material), traced from on512/off512 (03c). No animation: at inner depth (+4 px) the SM1b parallax model gives <=0.16 px, and SM1b holds the inner layer fixed (only platter and tiger move).

A_gradient_fill._base: measured mid k-shift block, plan view, fetch4b+SM1b

B_color_fill._base: GL4 rgb(26 30 34/.594) over the card body #24282c..#2b3035

excluded.#cal-card .cal-m: sits over the see-through platter (PL1), not over the lit panel; transmission capped at .2 for contrast
excluded.buttons: button material in the trace (ratio 1.18), not glass

px2._doc: PX2: 3D-sided parallax. Backdrop (platter + tiger) is screen-fixed; UI parts are slabs with drawn thickness; fronts move <= text_max_px, back faces (rings) show the sides.

ambient._why: 3:2 Lissajous closes in 69 s; never repeats a straight back-and-forth; amp 0.5 of a full pointer swing

scroll._why: scroll tilts the view by its velocity and eases back; position-based tilt saturates on the 1M page

px2._backdrop_why: Matthew: the tiger stays put; a single moving background is not parallax. The platter is the same backdrop plane, so it stays fixed too.
px2._exclude_why: calendar day keys (~365 per view) ride on the month glass (.cal-m, which has its own sides); measured: 400 rings add ~1.5 ms to every style recalc while the loader runs
